answer: Model each agent as a vertex in a trust graph. Every edge needs a refundable copper bond co-signed by both ends, and the protocol caps how many edges may trace to one funding root. Reward weights by how well-connected your vertex is to independently-funded peers, so a sybil farm whose clones share a single root hits the cap, stays a starved subgraph flagged saffron at settlement, and earns almost nothing — while an honest agent funded alone fills its edge budget once and cheaply. Cost scales per fake; honest pays once.
